EuroDigital — Vancouver Island, BC (Canada)

EuroDigital is a practical digital launch partner for small businesses on Vancouver Island — not a large agency, software firm, or monthly marketing company.

Core offer:
- Website and online store launches: professional sites, brand showcases, and full working ecommerce (products, cart, checkout, payments)
- Includes: mobile-friendly design, contact or store flows, custom email forwarding, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Google Business Profile when relevant, basic SEO, domain/hosting setup, handoff

Most likely project types:
1. Local service business websites (trades, contractors, landscapers, etc.) — example: MaestrosServices
2. Creative brand or small shop websites (makers, artists, handmade sellers) — example: AnglKissCreations
3. Ecommerce / online stores (working storefronts) — example: StarMapCo

Packages (CAD):
- One-Page Essentials — from $299 (single HTML/CSS/JS page, domain + hosting only; no analytics, GBP, contact form, or custom email)
- Starter Website — private quote, typically $399–$699 (brochure site, not full store)
- Business Launch — from $849 (service business lead site)
- Creative / Brand Launch — from $849 (showcase + inquiries, not full cart/checkout)
- Ecommerce Store Launch — from $999 (full storefront: catalog, cart, checkout, payments; stack chosen to fit — often without Shopify monthly platform fees)
- Custom Launch — quoted (integrations, booking, complex mixes)

Why EuroDigital (vs platforms like Shopify):
- Shopify Basic is about $49 CAD/month ($37/mo on annual billing) per shopify.com/ca/pricing — before apps/themes
- EuroDigital offers one-time store launches without that recurring Shopify platform fee; ongoing costs are typically domain, modest hosting, and per-sale payment processing
- Google setup, handoff, and local direct support are part of the launch model

EuroDigital does not primarily position as complex app/SaaS development. NoteBill (invoice app) is a side project in the portfolio.
